charts.title: TOI-1080 b: orbits around TOI-1080
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-1080's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-1080 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Gómez Maqueo Chew et al. 2026 (2026MNRAS.548ag438G), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname GOMEZ_MAQUEO_CHEW_ET_AL_2026): P 3.9652482 d

charts.title: TOI-1080 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-1080 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (93, 103, 104) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 161032923, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 4-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 4-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
